name: Pfalzgrafenweiler (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically yellow and red, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Pfalzgrafenweiler (a crown above a pick and hammer on red).
history: Municipal flag of Pfalzgrafenweiler; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Pfalzgrafenweiler arms — crown, pick and hammer on red
